readout_other: blink counts from EOG; urge-to-blink ratings; TUS detection ratings
direction_notes: Anterior insula TUS acutely increased blink frequency without altering urge; posterior insula TUS produced delayed increases in blinks and urge; ventricle (control site) TUS reduced blink frequency during stimulation only.
safety_notes: Side-effect questionnaire before, immediately after and 24 h after TUS; scores were higher before TUS than after; no temperature rises or significant side effects reported.

device.model: CTX-500-4CH transducer with NeuroFUS PRO TPO-203

timing.protocol_description: Single 80 s sonication delivered during block 5 of a 15-block (3 min each) blink suppression task; pulse duration 20 ms, pulse repetition interval 200 ms. Identical parameters at all three targets; one target per visit, three visits at least one week apart.
